title: Amendment to the Agreement Establishing CASSOS
text:
AMENDMENT TO
THE AGREEMENT ESTABLISHING
THE CARIBBEAN AVIATION SAFETY AND
SECURITY OVERSIGHT SYSTEM (CASSOS)

AMENDMENT TO
THE AGREEMENT ESTABLISHING
THE CARIBBEAN AVIATION SAFETY AND
SECURITY OVERSIGHT SYSTEM (CASSOS)
THE PARTIES:
ACKNOWLEDGING that the Agreement Establishing the Caribbean Aviation
Safety and Security Oversight System (CASSOS) entered into force on 3 July 2008
in accordance with Article XX thereof;
DESIROUS of clarifying the provisions of the Agreement in respect of the
contributions of the Parties to the Budget of CASSOS;
RECALLING the decision of the Twenty-Seventh Meeting of the Council for Trade
and Economic Development, held in Georgetown, Guyana, 11-15 May, 2009,
approving the proposed amendments to the Agreement;
RECALLING ALSO Article XXII of the Agreement, which provides that the
Agreement may be amended by the Parties and that amendments shall enter
into force immediately upon signature by the Parties;
HAVE AGREED as follows:
1

ARTICLE I
This Agreement amends the Agreement Establishing the Caribbean
Aviation Safety and Security Oversight System (CASSOS) (hereinafter referred to
as “the Agreement”) and shall be read and interpreted together with the
Agreement as a single document.
ARTICLE II
1. Article I of the Agreement is amended by deleting the definition of
“Member State” and inserting the following –
‘“Member” means Member of the Community pursuant to Article 3 of
the Revised Treaty;’
2. The Agreement is amended by replacing the words “Member States” or
“Member State” with the words “Members” or “Member” respectively, in the
following Articles (except where preceded by the term “OECS”) -
(i) Preamble, paragraphs beginning with “ACKNOWLEDGING” and
“CONVINCED”;
(ii) Article IV, paragraph 1;
(iii) Article XII, sub-paragraph (g)(v);
(iv) Article XVI, paragraph 2;
2

(v) Article XIX;
(vi) Article XX, paragraphs 1 and 2;
(vii) Article XXI, paragraph 1; and
(viii) Article XXIII, paragraph 1.
ARTICLE III
The Agreement is amended by replacing the words “States Parties” or
“State Party” wherever they occur in the Agreement, with the word “Parties” or
“Party” respectively.
ARTICLE IV
Article VIII of the Agreement is amended by replacing sub-paragraph
(2)(d) with the following:
“(d) approve the financial structure, programme of activities and
budget for CASSOS on an annual basis;”
ARTICLE V
Article XV of the Agreement is amended by replacing sub-paragraph (1)(a) with
the following:
3

“(a) contributions of Parties, which shall be made on an equal basis to
the annual budget;”
ARTICLE VI
This Agreement is open to signature by all Parties to the Agreement.
ARTICLE V
This Agreement shall enter into force in accordance with Article XXII of the
Agreement.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undermentioned representatives duly authorised in
that behalf have executed this Agreement for their respective Governments.
